name: undercrank
description: The Undercrank - a steampunk roguelike twin-stick shooter with co-op

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.desktop: npm --prefix desktop install && npm --prefix desktop start
scripts.desktop:dist: npm --prefix desktop install && npm --prefix desktop run dist
